absorption: The base Compose configuration no longer publishes the database port or the local port ownership constraint disappears.

consumers.name: Local deployments where another service owns host port 5432.

contract: Honcho PostgreSQL remains private to the Compose network and does not claim host port 5432.

fork: docker compose -f docker-compose.yml.example -f docker-compose.override.yml config --format json | python -c 'import json,sys; p=json.load(sys.stdin)["services"]["database"].get("ports", []); assert p == [], p; print("database-ports-ok")'`.
proof.fork_expected: the merged Compose model has no database host ports.
upstream: inspect the database service port publication on the recorded upstream base without the fork override.
proof.upstream_expected: the base configuration exposes a host database port.

upstream_gap: The recorded upstream base publishes the database port in a way that conflicts with another local service owning localhost:5432.
